title: Anchor with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Stock/shank of anchor -->
  <rect x="45" y="20" width="10" height="50" rx="3" fill="#5BA4E8"/>
  <!-- Light highlight on shank -->
  <rect x="47" y="22" width="3" height="46" rx="1.5" fill="#8CC4F5"/>
  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5BA4E8" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#8CC4F5" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Crossbar -->
  <rect x="28" y="40" width="44" height="8" rx="4" fill="#F0A030"/>
  <rect x="28" y="40" width="44" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#F7C870"/>
  <!-- Left arm curving down -->
  <path d="M30 48 Q18 55 18 72 Q18 85 35 88" fill="none" stroke="#5BA4E8" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 48 Q20 56 20 72 Q20 83 34 86" fill="none" stroke="#8CC4F5" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Right arm curving down -->
  <path d="M70 48 Q82 55 82 72 Q82 85 65 88" fill="none" stroke="#5BA4E8" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M70 48 Q80 56 80 72 Q80 83 66 86" fill="none" stroke="#8CC4F5" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Left fluke -->
  <path d="M35 88 Q22 92 14 82 Q22 96 35 92 Z" fill="#F0A030"/>
  <!-- Right fluke -->
  <path d="M65 88 Q78 92 86 82 Q78 96 65 92 Z" fill="#F0A030"/>
  <!-- Smiling face on shank area -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="57" r="3" fill="#FFE04D"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="57" r="3" fill="#FFE04D"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="56" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="56" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M42 64 Q50 72 58 64" fill="none" stroke="#FFE04D" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
